youtube_description:
We're back with Season 3 and what a better way to kick it off than a trip to dah UP. eh?!?!
As is tradition, the crew is kicking off the summer by heading to Fish Lake Island in the Hiawatha National Forest in Michigan's Upper Peninsula for a week of fun, food, friends and fishing.  Nothing beats camping on an island with your dog, but we've got to get there first! 
Join Drew for the first part of their adventure to Fish Lake, as he heads up early to set up camp and scout fishing holes for those world class Michigan Northern Pike. It's his first time taking out the "new" MIAdventureBoat, and he chose to do it miles from any cell service... what could go wrong???

Thanks for watching! Please remember to give this video a thumbs up and SUBSCRIBE to our channel... Ring the bell so you can tune in next week when Drew finally gets to fishing.
